overview_description.description:
SalesSift helps you to find the best companies to sell to.Their platform uses machine learning and harnesses the enormous volume of data available across the web to bring laser focus to your lead generation process.

Find similar businesses by entering the web address of an existing customer.

Or create your own custom queries to find companies based upon industry, revenue, location, age, or even products they import or export.

Alternatively, make use of their accounting search engine to find organisations with certain key terms in their reported accounts.
